name: Compile Unity C# outside the editor
description: Compile a Unity checkout's C# without opening the editor, using the main project's compiled response files, defines, references and analyzers, so a git worktree used by a parallel agent can be checked for compiler errors in seconds. Returns errors only. Needs the main project opened in the Unity editor once (Library/Bee/artifacts). Example for the Mad Max game: ownedPrefixes ["Assets/MadMax/"].

root.description: checkout to compile, default the cwd

mainProject.description: the Unity project the editor compiled (has Library/Bee); default env UNITY_MAIN_PROJECT, then root

unityEditorData.description: the editor's .../Editor/Data folder when it is not under the Unity Hub (or env UNITY_EDITOR_DATA)

ownedPrefixes.description: Assets/ prefixes the checkout owns: a file missing there is not borrowed from the main project

dryRun.description: resolve the editor, compiler and response files and report any problem, without compiling

outputs: { ok, errorCount, errors["File.cs(12,5): error CS0103: ..."], more?, unityVersion }
